history.summary: A newly inaugurated Hindu temple complex beside Grand Trunk Road in the Gopalmath area of Durgapur, also known as the Gopalmath Shiv Mandir. Devoted to Shiva; described as one of the largest temple premises in Durgapur, with a large marble-floored courtyard. A small artificial pond beside the temple is said to be filled with holy water from the Ganga (local claim, unverified). Identity confirmed via multiple local listings and vlogs; exact opening hours vary between sources (flagged below).

name: Shiv Shakti Dham (Gopalmath Shiv Mandir)
town_description: Durgapur is a major industrial city in Paschim Bardhaman district, West Bengal. Gopalmath is a locality on Grand Trunk Road towards Asansol, served by the Gopalmath bus stand; geocoders place the temple site under Ondal (PIN 713203), adjacent to Gopalmath/Durgapur (PIN 713217).

travel.railway: Durgapur, Waria or Andal station, then bus towards Gopalmath
travel.road: Beside Grand Trunk Road, Gopalmath, Durgapur; take the side lane before the Gopalmath flyover; alight at Gopalmath bus stand and cross GT Road

visitor_information.opening_hours: 8:30 AM-12:00 PM and 5:00 PM-7:00 PM per Google listing via beautyofdurgapur; other listings say 8:00 AM-12:00 PM / 4:00 PM-6:00 PM or 8:00-11:00 AM / 5:00-6:30 PM (verify on visit).
